'''''Solanum bonariense''''' is a [[species]] of plant in the [[nightshade]] family.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Solanum bonariense |url=https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/taxonomy/744058/names/ |access-date=2026-09-08 |website=NCBI |language=en}}</ref> It is a shrub native to northeastern Argentina, southeastern and southern Brazil, and Uruguay.<ref name = powo/>
